nurse.text: Hello, dear! Come in, Manx weather's not for the faint-hearted. Cup of tea?
What can we do for you?

then.text: Right-o, give them here. We'll have them champion in no time.
There you are. Better than new. Off you pop.
The Ark is by the window. No cats in it, please. We've tried.

else.text: No problem. Mind the gulls on the way out. They know.
